scope: Interactive read-only original-worksheet inspection; no financial, source-verification or exporter changes.
implementation: Native Streamlit Components v2 with local vanilla JavaScript/CSS; no new dependencies or frontend framework.
Click selection, green Excel-style border, four-arrow roving grid focus, coordinate name box / jump, and original formula-or-raw-value bar.
Selection, formula, source metadata and bounded range update synchronously in the component; no Python rerun for each selection.
12 rows × 4 columns desktop; 8 rows × 2 columns phone. Viewport shifts at each grid edge and clamps at actual worksheet bounds.
Worksheet selection and fresh citation-opening identities retain exact valid original targets.
Optional cell provenance, original observed value/units, standardized value and comments; no duplicate formula expander.
Original filenames, strict source allowlist/hash verification, downloads and derived operand controls reused unchanged.

validation.secret_audit: Exact changed-path allowlist / high-confidence credential scan passed; no credential or environment files read.

bounded_review: Workbook strings enter the component as serialized data and are displayed only through textContent/value. No HTML interpretation, formula execution, editing or clipboard spreadsheet handlers.
Keyboard listeners attach only to the worksheet table; modifier shortcuts and focus outside data cells are left alone.
Removed obsolete global source-grid CSS; component styling is isolated in its shadow root.
Actual screenshots inspected: initial cited context for each company and a 390px phone grid; no page/table horizontal overflow.
limitations: Bounded original worksheet reconstruction; merged layouts, embedded artwork and charts are not reproduced.
Formula bar shows original formula text; grid uses original cached values or clearly attributed approved retained source observations. No recalculation.
A different worksheet starts at A1; returning to the cited sheet starts at its original citation. Cursor history is not persisted across sheets or dialog openings.
Native dialog owns vertical scrolling while open; the worksheet has no separate scrolling panel.
